properties.evidence_text: The requirements of § 33.63 apply to the engine, its components, and systems operating throughout the declared flight envelope and ranges of rotational speeds and power/thrust.

document_metadata.license_or_basis: US government-authored text; excludes third-party material

properties.evidence_text: All engine components are exposed to some level of vibration, which depends on the components' design characteristics, such as geometry or materials, and the operating environment, such as the sources of excitations or aerodynamic forces.
properties.evidence_text_zh: 所有发动机部件都会承受一定程度的振动，这取决于部件的设计特性（如几何形状或材料）以及运行环境（如激励源或气动力）。

document_metadata.license_or_basis: US government-authored text; excludes third-party material

properties.evidence_text: Components directly in the airflow, such as the blades or vanes, are excited by disturbances from the wakes of stators, vanes, struts, but also by inlet distortions and other sources.

document_metadata.license_or_basis: US government-authored text; excludes third-party material

properties.evidence_text: Blades may also be subjected to vibration driven by instabilities such as stall or flutter.
properties.evidence_text_zh: 叶片还可能受到由失速或颤振等不稳定性驱动的振动。

properties.document_display_name: 涡轮发动机振动指导资料（资料节选）.pdf

document_metadata.license_or_basis: US government-authored text; excludes third-party material

properties.evidence_text: The amplitude of blade and vane resonant response depends on damping and aerodynamic forces.
properties.evidence_text_zh: 叶片和导叶共振响应的幅值取决于阻尼和气动力。

properties.document_display_name: 涡轮发动机振动指导资料（资料节选）.pdf

document_metadata.license_or_basis: US government-authored text; excludes third-party material

properties.evidence_text: Other components, like those installed on the engine case, are excited by rotor unbalance and vibrate at frequencies associated with the source of excitation.

document_metadata.license_or_basis: US government-authored text; excludes third-party material

properties.evidence_text: On the other hand, engine vibration accepted or observed during compliance with other part 33 standards should be verified against the engine vibratory characteristics and vibration envelope for which compliance with § 33.63 is shown.

properties.evidence_text: Vibration stresses above endurance limits result in high cycle fatigue damage.
properties.evidence_text_zh: 超过耐久极限的振动应力会导致高周疲劳损伤。

properties.evidence_text: Rotor mass imbalance, commonly known as unbalance, is due to the eccentricity of the rotor mass center relative to its axis of rotation.

properties.evidence_text: This unbalance is generally the result of rotor manufacture and assembly, and, although unavoidable, can be reduced through compensating techniques.
